content.title: Co-op Game Intro Generator
content.summary: Lock two characters, player information, and menu layout, then use visible interaction to complete the cooperative opening; the Seedance companion reinforces identity, screen position, and a clear final UI-copy state.

quick_start.input_format: Two player identities + stable character positions + menu and UI layout + one visible cooperative interaction + final readable game state
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock two characters, player information, and menu layout, then use visible interaction to complete the cooperative opening; the Seedance companion reinforces identity, screen position, and a clear final UI-copy state.
required_anchors: Use the pinned official MiniMax H3 upstream Skill.
Use the independent Seedance 2.0 companion for Seedance.
Do not copy the upstream Skill body or duplicate it into ComfyUI.
usage_steps: Choose the matching official MiniMax H3 Skill and install it from the pinned upstream link.
Prepare only the assets and facts required by that Skill.
Use the independent Seedance companion when targeting Seedance 2.0.
Validate identity, timing, text and asset responsibilities before generation.
applicable_scope: Lock both character identities, player information, and menu layout, then use visible interaction to complete the cooperative opening; the Seedance companion reinforces identity, screen position, and a clear final UI-copy state.
Projects that match the upstream Skill's declared purpose and asset contract.
not_suitable_for: Tasks outside the upstream Skill's declared scope.
Cases that require copying the upstream Skill body into this library or importing it into the T8 ComfyUI node.

creative_dna.usage_scope: Lock both character identities, player information, and menu layout, then use visible interaction to complete the cooperative opening; the Seedance companion reinforces identity, screen position, and a clear final UI-copy state.
